perform: PERFORM UNTIL PR-EOF OR FATAL-ERROR IF PR-POLICY-NO < PI-POLICY-NO PERFORM READ-PROPERTY ELSE IF PR-POLICY-NO = PI-POLICY-NO MOVE PR-PROPERTY-VALUE TO WS-RISK-VALUE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PR-FOUND END-IF EXIT PERFORM END-IF END-PERFORM

PERFORM UNTIL VE-EOF OR FATAL-ERROR IF VE-POLICY-NO < PI-POLICY-NO PERFORM READ-VEHICLE ELSE IF VE-POLICY-NO = PI-POLICY-NO MOVE VE-VEHICLE-VALUE TO WS-RISK-VALUE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-VE-FOUND END-IF EXIT PERFORM END-IF END-PERFORM

PERFORM UNTIL CO-EOF OR FATAL-ERROR IF CO-POLICY-NO < PI-POLICY-NO PERFORM READ-COVERAGE ELSE IF CO-POLICY-NO = PI-POLICY-NO MOVE 'Y' TO WS-CO-FOUND ADD CO-COVERAGE-LIMIT TO WS-COV-LIMIT-TOTAL ADD CO-DEDUCTIBLE TO WS-DEDUCT-TOTAL ADD 1 TO WS-COVERAGE-COUNT PERFORM READ-COVERAGE ELSE EXIT PERFORM END-IF END-IF END-PERFORM
read: READ-PROPERTY PERFORM READ-VEHICLE PERFORM READ-COVERAGE PERFORM UNTIL POL-EOF OR FATAL-ERROR PERFORM READ-POLICY IF NOT POL-EOF AND NOT FATAL-ERROR ADD 1 TO WS-READ PERFORM PROCESS-POLICY END-IF END-PERFORM PERFORM CLOSE-FILES DISPLAY 'PREMCALC READ : ' WS-READ DISPLAY 'PREMCALC CALCULATED : ' WS-CALCULATED DISPLAY 'PREMCALC ERRORS : ' WS-ERRORS DISPLAY 'PREMCALC I/O ERRORS : ' WS-IO-ERRORS IF FATAL-ERROR MOVE 12 TO RETURN-CODE END-IF GOBACK
READ POLICY-IN AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-POL-EOF NOT AT END IF WS-PI-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'POLICY READ ERROR ' WS-PI-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF END-READ
READ PROPERTY-IN AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PR-EOF NOT AT END IF WS-PR-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'PROPERTY READ ERROR ' WS-PR-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF END-READ END-IF
READ VEHICLE-IN AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-VE-EOF NOT AT END IF WS-VE-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'VEHICLE READ ERROR ' WS-VE-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF END-READ END-IF
READ COVERAGE-IN AT END MOVE 'Y' TO WS-CO-EOF NOT AT END IF WS-CO-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'COVERAGE READ ERROR ' WS-CO-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF END-READ END-IF
READ-PROPERTY ELSE IF PR-POLICY-NO = PI-POLICY-NO MOVE PR-PROPERTY-VALUE TO WS-RISK-VALUE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PR-FOUND END-IF EXIT PERFORM END-IF END-PERFORM
READ-VEHICLE ELSE IF VE-POLICY-NO = PI-POLICY-NO MOVE VE-VEHICLE-VALUE TO WS-RISK-VALUE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-VE-FOUND END-IF EXIT PERFORM END-IF END-PERFORM

READ-COVERAGE ELSE IF CO-POLICY-NO = PI-POLICY-NO MOVE 'Y' TO WS-CO-FOUND ADD CO-COVERAGE-LIMIT TO WS-COV-LIMIT-TOTAL ADD CO-DEDUCTIBLE TO WS-DEDUCT-TOTAL ADD 1 TO WS-COVERAGE-COUNT PERFORM READ-COVERAGE ELSE EXIT PERFORM END-IF END-IF END-PERFORM
write: WRITE PO-REC IF WS-PO-ST = '00' ADD 1 TO WS-CALCULATED ELSE ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS MOVE 'P901' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'PREMIUM OUTPUT WRITE FAILED' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR END-IF
WRITE ER-REC IF WS-ER-ST = '00' ADD 1 TO WS-ERRORS ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT WRITE FAILED ' WS-ER-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF
move: MOVE 'Y' TO WS-POL-EOF NOT AT END IF WS-PI-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'POLICY READ ERROR ' WS-PI-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF END-READ
MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PR-EOF NOT AT END IF WS-PR-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'PROPERTY READ ERROR ' WS-PR-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF END-READ END-IF
MOVE 'Y' TO WS-VE-EOF NOT AT END IF WS-VE-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'VEHICLE READ ERROR ' WS-VE-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF END-READ END-IF
MOVE 'Y' TO WS-CO-EOF NOT AT END IF WS-CO-ST NOT = '00' DISPLAY 'COVERAGE READ ERROR ' WS-CO-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF END-READ END-IF

MOVE 'N' TO WS-PR-FOUND PERFORM UNTIL PR-EOF OR FATAL-ERROR IF PR-POLICY-NO < PI-POLICY-NO PERFORM READ-PROPERTY ELSE IF PR-POLICY-NO = PI-POLICY-NO MOVE PR-PROPERTY-VALUE TO WS-RISK-VALUE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-PR-FOUND END-IF EXIT PERFORM END-IF END-PERFORM

MOVE 'N' TO WS-VE-FOUND PERFORM UNTIL VE-EOF OR FATAL-ERROR IF VE-POLICY-NO < PI-POLICY-NO PERFORM READ-VEHICLE ELSE IF VE-POLICY-NO = PI-POLICY-NO MOVE VE-VEHICLE-VALUE TO WS-RISK-VALUE MOVE 'Y' TO WS-VE-FOUND END-IF EXIT PERFORM END-IF END-PERFORM

MOVE 'N' TO WS-CO-FOUND PERFORM UNTIL CO-EOF OR FATAL-ERROR IF CO-POLICY-NO < PI-POLICY-NO PERFORM READ-COVERAGE ELSE IF CO-POLICY-NO = PI-POLICY-NO MOVE 'Y' TO WS-CO-FOUND ADD CO-COVERAGE-LIMIT TO WS-COV-LIMIT-TOTAL ADD CO-DEDUCTIBLE TO WS-DEDUCT-TOTAL ADD 1 TO WS-COVERAGE-COUNT PERFORM READ-COVERAGE ELSE EXIT PERFORM END-IF END-IF END-PERFORM

MOVE WS-HO-MAX-DISC TO WS-DISCOUNT END-IF COMPUTE WS-PREMIUM ROUNDED = WS-HO-BASE + (WS-RISK-VALUE * WS-HO-RISK-RATE) + (WS-COV-LIMIT-TOTAL * WS-HO-COV-RATE) - WS-DISCOUNT IF WS-PREMIUM < WS-HO-MIN MOVE WS-HO-MIN TO WS-PREMIUM END-IF

MOVE WS-AU-MAX-DISC TO WS-DISCOUNT END-IF COMPUTE WS-PREMIUM ROUNDED = WS-AU-BASE + (WS-RISK-VALUE * WS-AU-RISK-RATE) + (WS-COV-LIMIT-TOTAL * WS-AU-COV-RATE) - WS-DISCOUNT IF WS-PREMIUM < WS-AU-MIN MOVE WS-AU-MIN TO WS-PREMIUM END-IF

MOVE PI-POLICY-NO(1:6) TO PO-PREMIUM-ID(1:6) MOVE WS-CURRENT-DATE(3:6) TO PO-PREMIUM-ID(7:6) MOVE PI-POLICY-NO TO PO-POLICY-NO MOVE WS-PREMIUM TO PO-WRITTEN-PREMIUM MOVE ZERO TO PO-EARNED-PREMIUM MOVE WS-PREMIUM TO PO-UNEARNED-PREMIUM MOVE WS-CURRENT-DATE TO PO-CALCULATION-DATE WRITE PO-REC IF WS-PO-ST = '00' ADD 1 TO WS-CALCULATED ELSE ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS MOVE 'P901' TO ER-CODE MOVE 'PREMIUM OUTPUT WRITE FAILED' TO ER-MESSAGE PERFORM WRITE-ERROR END-IF
MOVE PI-POLICY-NO TO ER-POLICY-NO WRITE ER-REC IF WS-ER-ST = '00' ADD 1 TO WS-ERRORS ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OUTPUT WRITE FAILED ' WS-ER-ST ADD 1 TO WS-IO-ERRORS SET FATAL-ERROR TO TRUE END-IF
open: OPEN-FILES IF FATAL-ERROR GOBACK END-IF PERFORM READ-PROPERTY PERFORM READ-VEHICLE PERFORM READ-COVERAGE PERFORM UNTIL POL-EOF OR FATAL-ERROR PERFORM READ-POLICY IF NOT POL-EOF AND NOT FATAL-ERROR ADD 1 TO WS-READ PERFORM PROCESS-POLICY END-IF END-PERFORM PERFORM CLOSE-FILES DISPLAY 'PREMCALC READ : ' WS-READ DISPLAY 'PREMCALC CALCULATED : ' WS-CALCULATED DISPLAY 'PREMCALC ERRORS : ' WS-ERRORS DISPLAY 'PREMCALC I/O ERRORS : ' WS-IO-ERRORS IF FATAL-ERROR MOVE 12 TO RETURN-CODE END-IF GOBACK
close: CLOSE-FILES DISPLAY 'PREMCALC READ : ' WS-READ DISPLAY 'PREMCALC CALCULATED : ' WS-CALCULATED DISPLAY 'PREMCALC ERRORS : ' WS-ERRORS DISPLAY 'PREMCALC I/O ERRORS : ' WS-IO-ERRORS IF FATAL-ERROR MOVE 12 TO RETURN-CODE END-IF GOBACK
CLOSE POLICY-IN PROPERTY-IN VEHICLE-IN COVERAGE-IN PREMIUM-OUT ERROR-OUT
